story: The American suburbs are a giant Ponzi scheme
text: The End of Suburbia is a rabidly biased documentary that takes another perspective on why the suburbs will fail, the cost of oil: [LINK] And in free as in beer, glorious 240p: [VIDEO] It's entertaining and, IMO, well worth watching even if you disagree with some of the people they interview or prefer your documentaries balanced and dispassionate. You're sure to come away from the movie feeling you know more about the history of the relationship between the automobile and the suburbs.

story: The American suburbs are a giant Ponzi scheme
text: There's actually a section in the movie on the subject of electricity: [VIDEO] And later on they discuss hybrids and electric cars specifically. But to be clear, I don't recommend the movie because it's right , but because it asks interesting questions and leads you to think about interesting possibilities. We use a lot of energy. If we're going to replace the energy from fossil fuels with energy from electricity, we are going to need a lot more capacity than we have today. And as you can see from recent news, doubling or trebling our capacity is no small feat.
